units.source_text: 时候已过夜半，风渐渐紧起来。

en.t: It was already past midnight, and the wind was gradually growing stronger.

units.source_text: 茂密的松林发出凄惨的啸声。

en.t: The dense pine woods gave out a mournful howling sound.

units.source_text: 怪鸟作出枯嗄的叫声，这大概就是猫头鹰吧。

en.t: Some strange bird cried in a dry, hoarse voice; it was probably an owl.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想来想去，四周渺若烟云，全无声息。

en.t: Prince Genji turned the matter over and over in his mind, while all around him lay vague as mist and utterly silent.

units.source_text: “我为什么到这种荒僻地方来投宿呢？”

en.t: Why did I come to lodge in such a desolate, out-of-the-way place?

units.source_text: 他心中后悔，然而无法挽救了。

en.t: He regretted it bitterly in his heart, but there was no way to undo it now.

units.source_text: 右近已经不省人事，紧紧地偎在源氏公子身旁，浑身发抖，竟像要抖死了。

en.t: Ukon had already lost consciousness; she pressed tightly against Prince Genji, trembling all over as if she might shake herself to death.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“难道这个人也不中用了？”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, Has even this woman become useless too?

units.source_text: 他只是茫茫然地把右近紧紧抱住。

en.t: He could only hold Ukon tightly in a daze.

units.source_text: 此时这屋子里只有他一个人像人，然而一点办法也想不出来。

en.t: At that moment, he alone in the house seemed still human, yet he could not think of the slightest thing to do.

units.source_text: 灯光忽明忽暗，仿佛在眨眼，凄凉地照映着正屋边的屏风和室内各个角落。

en.t: The lamplight flickered bright and dim as if blinking, bleakly illuminating the screens beside the main room and every corner within.

units.source_text: 背后似乎有窸窸窣窣的脚步声正在走近来。

en.t: Behind him there seemed to be a rustling sound of footsteps drawing nearer.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“惟光早点来才好。”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, If only Koremitsu would come soon.

units.source_text: 然而这惟光浮踪浪迹，宿所无定，使者东寻西找，一直找到天亮。

en.t: But Koremitsu lived a wandering life with no fixed lodging, and the messenger searched east and west until daybreak.

units.source_text: 这一段时间在源氏公子看来仿佛过了千夜。

en.t: To Prince Genji, that stretch of time felt as though a thousand nights had passed.

units.source_text: 好容易听见远方鸡鸣。

en.t: At last he heard a rooster crowing in the distance.

units.source_text: 源氏公子回肠百转地思量：“我前世作了什么孽，今世消受这性命攸关的忧患呢？

en.t: With his heart twisting in anguish, Prince Genji thought, What sin did I commit in a former life that I must now endure this life-threatening misery?

units.source_text: 罪由心生，这是我在色情上犯了这逆天背理、无可辩解的罪过所得的报应，故而发生这罕有其例的横事吧。

en.t: Sin is born from the heart; this must be the retribution for the indefensible offense I committed in passion, defying heaven and betraying what is right, and so this almost unheard-of calamity has occurred.

units.source_text: 无论怎样秘密，既有其事，终难隐藏。

en.t: No matter how secret it is kept, once such a thing has happened, it can hardly remain hidden forever.

units.source_text: 宫中自不必说；世人闻知，亦必群起指责，我就被世间轻薄少年当作话柄了。

en.t: The court, of course, will know; and when people hear of it, they will surely rise up to condemn me, and I will become gossip for the frivolous young men of the world.

units.source_text: 想不到我在今日博得了一个愚痴的恶名！”

en.t: I never imagined that today I would earn myself such a foolish disgrace!
